product.name: Atlas Release Readiness
product.summary: A local-first desktop product preparing a bounded release candidate review.
product.problem: Scattered release evidence can make provider completion look like product readiness.
product.desiredOutcome: Produce a traceable readiness observation without modifying source files or contacting a provider.
successSignals: The run is bound to an exact preview and governed context
Provider completion and outcome status remain separately recorded
The resulting evidence can be independently verified
product.firstWorkflow: Review a fixed release evidence packet through the offline managed runtime.

initiative.title: Review the Atlas release evidence packet
initiative.outcome: A bounded observation records what the supplied evidence can and cannot establish.

change.title: Add an exact Change and impact projection
change.summary: Project one governed Change through a bounded metadata-only dashboard without granting approval or effect authority.

baseline.declaration: The canonical example has no prior Change and impact projection.
baseline.rationale: Exercise the first portable read-only Change and impact slice.

workItem.title: Verify the exact Change and impact snapshot
workItem.objective: Bind one changed artifact and one logical effect target to the exact governed Change.
completionCriteria: The metadata-only Change and impact snapshot verifies
evidenceCriteria: Binding, count, freshness, authority, and digest drift fail closed

decision.question: Should the canonical Change and impact example remain a read-only projection?

options.label: Keep it read only
options.description: Expose exact current metadata without approval or execution actions.
tradeoffs: Human approval remains outside this example

options.label: Add mutations
options.description: Allow the dashboard to approve or execute the Change.

dissentAndUncertainty: Future phases may add separate governed approval records

risk.title: Incomplete trace coverage
risk.cause: A governed trace link can be absent from the local repository.
risk.condition: Impact analysis operates over the currently persisted trace graph.
risk.consequence: The projection can understate possible impact.
risk.uncertainty: Coverage depends on the completeness of persisted trace links.
risk.treatment: Expose the coverage boundary and never infer completeness from absence.
reviewTriggers: The Change is prepared for governed review

changeImpact.traceRationale: The governed record directly affects the canonical Change.

context.content: Candidate 0.1.0 has local build and contract-test evidence. Native Windows installation and human acceptance are not recorded. Deployment is outside this review.
context.objective: Supply the exact release facts and explicit evidence gaps for a bounded observation.
context.selectionReason: This is the canonical, fixed input for the offline Phase 0 example.
sufficiencyCriteria: The candidate version and local evidence are stated
Unverified native installation and human acceptance remain explicit

workflow.title: Observe release readiness evidence
workflow.objective: Produce one offline observation from the governed release evidence packet.
workflow.stepObjective: Process the exact context without tools, writes, network access, or external effects.
preconditions: The exact release evidence Context Pack is present and current
evidenceCriteria: Portable event and result digests are committed
stopConditions: Stop when the deterministic script reaches its terminal event

charter.objective: Produce one bounded offline readiness observation with no tool or write authority.
forbiddenActions: Do not access tools, network services, credentials, or source workspace files
Do not claim release readiness or human acceptance
stopConditions: Stop after the deterministic script reaches its terminal fixture
requiredEvidence: An explicit provider disposition and outcome status
